item.title: ICE arrests 23-year-old UC Berkeley student and asylum seeker at San Francisco airport
item.description: A UC Berkeley student was arrested by Immigration and Customs Enforcement at San Francisco International Airport Friday while waiting to board a flight to Portland for a vacation with her boyfriend.

item.title: US charges son of Ecuador's former president, 4 others with cocaine trafficking
item.description: Federal prosecutors have charged a son of Ecuador’s former president, a former member of Ecuador’s legislature and three other Ecuadorians with trafficking tons of cocaine to the United States and Europe in part by hiding it in containers carrying tuna.

item.title: Declaration of final vote results in Serbia paves way for student movement to form government
item.description: Serbia’s election authorities have declared the final results of the Oct. 25 vote, paving the way for the formation of a new Parliament and government that will be dominated by a student movement which defeated former strongman Aleksandar Vucic and his party.

item.title: Seeds, preserved hair in tomb point to oldest signs of cannabis high 2,800 years ago, study suggests
item.description: A new study suggests people were using cannabis for psychoactive purposes at least 2,800 years ago. Archaeologists found evidence in a Siberian tomb, indicating cannabis use 300 years earlier than previously known in China.
